title: Bahía de Cochinos y misiles
goal: Read how the failed 1961 Bay of Pigs invasion and the October 1962 Missile Crisis brought the world closer to nuclear war than at any other moment in the Cold War.

items: Explain who landed at the Bay of Pigs and why.
State what happened to the invasion.
Describe what the United States discovered in October 1962.
Explain how the missile crisis was ultimately resolved.
Use estar a punto de + infinitive to describe a narrowly avoided event.
I can explain who landed at the Bay of Pigs and why.
I can state what happened to the invasion.
I can describe what the United States discovered in October 1962.
I can explain how the missile crisis was ultimately resolved.
I can use estar a punto de + infinitive to describe a narrowly avoided event.
